messages.text: BL-1887 🎵 in progress — Since BL-1871 landed, a git_handoff that routes a new ticket at a commit already on origin/main leaves the role on its previous ticket's line (the take-up stays when HEAD descends from the target, and every long-lived line descends from main): BL-1872 was routed at 095f2827a7 and the coder stayed on BL-1877's line; such a git_handoff now starts its ticket on a fresh line, as a Work note does
